title: 新书《满唐华彩》已发
content_zh:
新书《满唐华彩》已发
新书《满唐华彩》已发：
盛唐繁花似锦，惊天裂变在即。
天宝五载，他睁开眼，看到了“昭昭有唐，天俾万国”的盛世雄风，名将如云，疆土广袤；能臣如雨，仓廪丰盈；诗歌璀璨，文华耀目；美色倾城，歌舞升平。
他也看到了满朝如痴如醉，骄固奢靡，争权不休；江山飘摇，积弊丛生；胡儿叛乱，人如草芥。
渔阳鼙鼓动地来，他偏要让此唐不失华彩。
新书写的是安史之乱时期的故事，能写的故事、人物有很多，从繁华盛世到天下大乱，唐玄宗、唐肃宗、杨贵妃、梅妃、高力士、杨国忠、李林甫、安山、李白、杜甫、王维、颜真卿、郭子仪……我想着笔的也很多，就都放在剧情里吧，希望大家给我时间慢慢展开。
今天凌晨会先发两章，签约要到白天才可以完成，在签约之前不能投月票、不能打赏，恳请大家留月票投给新书。
再说几句心里话。
从《终宋》的故事结束，到《满唐华彩》开始，中间隔了十天。这十天我没有休息，查资料、构思、准备大纲，写出的废稿就有几万字。
我不是不累，不是不想休息，就是觉得《终宋》没能签约大神，我希望《满唐华彩》能够做到，打算用尽全力去做这件事。
嗯，我一直是不太喜欢说这些的，但确实想告诉大家，我想要争明年的大神。
成绩这种事离不开大家的支持，我也始终感激所有的读者。在此，我恳请大家能够支持新书，支持正版订阅，往后我应该会求很多很多次月票，打扰之处也请见谅。
新书期最重要的是追读数据，第一步的目标是需要1.5万的追读才能获得够好的推荐位，和终宋每天的追订是差不多的，所以厚颜拜托大家追读。
具体规则是，三个月内有充值记录的起点账号，在最新章节发布的24小时内追读，在新章节
这样的追读可能需要一个月，养书的读者方便的话可以帮忙把最新章开自动
全订读者可以进Q群（625508104），进微信盟主群请联系格格巫，发书和上架时我会在群里发红包。
感谢大家！
往后又是一场两年的旅程，由衷感激陪伴着的所有人。
那就一起开始吧。
content_en:
The new book "Huocai of the Tang Dynasty" has been released
The new book "Huocai of the Tang Dynasty" has been released:
In the prosperous Tang Dynasty, flowers bloomed, and a shocking fission was imminent.
After five years of Tianbao, he opened his eyes and saw the majesty of the prosperous age of "the Tang Dynasty is known, and God provides it to all countries". Famous generals are like clouds, the territory is vast, capable ministers are like rain, and barns are abundant. Poems are dazzling, culture is dazzling, beauty is alluring, singing and dancing are peaceful.
He also saw that the entire dynasty was obsessed with intoxication, arrogant and extravagant, and constantly fighting for power; the country was in turmoil, and there were many evils; the Hu'er rebelled, and the people were like grass and grass.
Yuyang Ji encouraged him to come, and he wanted to ensure that the Tang Dynasty would not lose its splendor.
The newly written story is about the Anshi Rebellion. There are many stories and characters that can be written, from the prosperous times to the chaos of the world, Tang Xuanzong, Tang Suzong, Yang Guifei, Mei Fei, Gao Lishi, Yang Guozhong, Li Linfu, Anshan, Li Bai, Du Fu, Wang Wei, Yan Zhenqing, Guo Ziyi... I have a lot to write about, so I will put them all in the plot. I hope everyone will give me time to unfold them slowly.
Two chapters will be released early this morning. The signing cannot be completed until daytime. No monthly votes or rewards can be cast before the signing. Please leave your monthly votes to vote for the new book.
A few more words from my heart.
From the end of the story of "The End of the Song Dynasty" to the beginning of "The Brilliance of the Tang Dynasty", there was an interval of ten days. I didn't rest for ten days. I checked information, came up with ideas, and prepared outlines. I wrote tens of thousands of words of scrap.
Either I'm not tired or I don't want to rest, I just feel that "The Last Song" failed to sign a great star. I hope "Man Tang Huacai" can do it, and I plan to do my best to do it.
Well, I don’t always like to say this, but I do want to tell everyone that I want to compete for the top spot next year.
Things like results are inseparable from everyone's support, and I am always grateful to all readers. Here, I urge everyone to support the new book and support genuine subscriptions. I will probably ask for many monthly passes in the future. Please forgive me for intruding.
The most important thing about the new book issue is the reading data. The first step goal is to get 15,000 readings to get a good enough recommendation position, which is similar to the daily readings of Zhongsong, so I have the audacity to ask everyone to follow up.
The specific rules are that starting accounts with recharge records within three months can read the latest chapter within 24 hours after it is released.
This kind of pursuit may take a month. If it is convenient for readers who keep books, they can help to open the latest chapter automatically.
Readers with full subscriptions can join the Q group (625508104). To join the WeChat leader group, please contact Gargamel. I will send red envelopes in the group when the book is released and put on the shelves.
Thank you all!
What follows is another two-year journey, and I am sincerely grateful to everyone who has accompanied me.
Then let’s get started together.
